preconditions.description: n is an even number representing the length of the sequence.
Each integer x_i on even positions in the sequence is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: output == 'No' or (output == 'Yes' and is_sequence_valid(x_1, x_2, ..., x_n))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'No' if there is no possible sequence, or 'Yes' followed by a sequence of n positive integers that satisfies the conditions.
